_from: docs/game-guide/templates/art-config.json. Circuit Racer (docs/CIRCUIT-ART-PLAN.md). Check with: python3 scripts/game_art.py circuit paint OUT --dry-run. The road, racer, chips, cables, sparks and gates stay drawn in three.js; these paintings set the mood. The home card waits in src/games/circuit/art/card/ until the code switch PR (Stage 6) moves it to src/assets/home.

pictures.name: world-motherboard
pictures.prompt: Wide distant backdrop for the Motherboard world: a vast deep green circuit board stretching to the horizon, glowing gold traces running in long straight lines and right angles, little black chips with gold pins, tiny glowing capacitors like towers, cyan sparks of data racing along the traces. A calm darker band across the middle and bottom so a glowing road placed on top stands out, the brightest light in the far distance, deep and huge. Wide landscape.

pictures.name: world-gpu
pictures.prompt: Wide distant backdrop for the Graphics Card world: a huge graphics card world in hot red and orange light, giant spinning cooling fans glowing at the edges, rows of copper heat-sink fins like tall cliffs, rainbow RGB light strips glowing magenta, orange and cyan, sparks of heat drifting up. A calm darker band across the middle and bottom so a glowing road placed on top stands out, the brightest light in the far distance, deep and huge. Wide landscape.

pictures.name: world-memory
pictures.prompt: Wide distant backdrop for the Memory Lanes world: long straight rows of enormous RAM memory sticks standing like tall blue and silver skyscrapers, lined with glowing blue chips, narrow canyons of cool blue light between them, silver and gold pins along the bottom, a cool blue glow. A calm darker band across the middle and bottom so a glowing road placed on top stands out, the brightest light in the far distance, deep and huge. Wide landscape.

pictures.name: world-cloud
pictures.prompt: Wide distant backdrop for the The Cloud world: a bright open sky of white and cyan glowing data clouds, floating platforms of circuit board drifting among the clouds, streams of glowing cyan data flowing between them like waterfalls of light, soft sunrise gold at the horizon, airy and light. A calm darker band across the middle and bottom so a glowing road placed on top stands out, the brightest light in the far distance, deep and huge. Wide landscape.

pictures.name: world-quantum
pictures.prompt: Wide distant backdrop for the Quantum Core world: a shimmering purple and gold quantum core, a giant glowing golden sphere of light in the distance with rings of light orbiting it, floating crystal chips, glitchy flickering purple pixels, twisting ribbons of violet and gold energy, mysterious and magical. A calm darker band across the middle and bottom so a glowing road placed on top stands out, the brightest light in the far distance, deep and huge. Wide landscape.

pictures.name: map
pictures.prompt: A giant computer world seen from high above at a slant, like a treasure map made of light: five glowing regions joined by one long winding glowing cyan path with small round glowing stops along it. Bottom left a green circuit board with gold traces and little chips, then a hot red and orange graphics card with spinning fans, then long rows of blue and silver RAM memory sticks, then white and cyan glowing data clouds, and at the top right a shimmering purple and gold quantum core sphere of light. Clear open spaces along the path, deep navy darkness between the regions, wide landscape.

pictures.name: finish-motherboard
pictures.prompt: Victory moment in the Motherboard world: a small glowing cyan spark racer, a sleek little hover-pod trailing a long streak of light, bursting out through a giant glowing green ring-shaped port, a huge celebration of fireworks made of sparks and light bursting all around in cyan, green and gold, set in a vast deep green circuit board stretching to the horizon, glowing gold traces running in long straight lines and right angles, little black chips with gold pins, tiny glowing capacitors like towers, cyan sparks of data racing along the traces. Exciting and joyful, the racer and port in the middle, wide landscape.

pictures.prompt: A long low racing dashboard panel filling the whole picture edge to edge, with three big empty dark round recesses evenly spaced along it for gauges, a wide empty dark screen in the middle, glowing neon rims around each recess, small glowing studs and vents, polished and sleek. pictures.prompt: Seamless tile: a dark navy circuit-board road surface with thin glowing cyan and gold circuit traces running in straight lines and right-angle turns, tiny round solder pads, faint grid. Even all over, the same pattern repeating.

pictures.name: racer-spark
pictures.prompt: Spark, a sleek little hover racer pod glowing electric cyan, a smooth rounded body with a bright white-blue light core, two big friendly glowing eyes on the front window, cyan light trails flowing behind. Racing pose, leaning forward, a little motion blur of light behind.

pictures.name: racer-pixel
pictures.prompt: Pixel, a chunky little hover racer made of glowing green blocks like pixels, square friendly glowing eyes, bright green neon edges, a cheeky grin. Racing pose, leaning forward, a little motion blur of light behind.

pictures.name: racer-byte
pictures.prompt: Byte, a sporty little hover racer in shining gold with glowing gold fins, a warm golden light core, determined friendly glowing eyes, gold sparks. Racing pose, leaning forward, a little motion blur of light behind.

pictures.name: racer-quark
pictures.prompt: Quark, a mysterious little hover racer that shimmers purple and gold, a glowing round violet orb body with orbiting rings of light, starry sparkles, kind glowing eyes. Racing pose, leaning forward, a little motion blur of light behind.

pictures.name: volt
pictures.prompt: Volt, a cute friendly little robot shaped like an electric plug: a rounded cyan and white plug body, two shiny gold prongs on top of its head like antennae, a round glowing blue screen face with big happy eyes and a smile, little round arms waving hello, short stubby legs, a coiled cable tail, glowing cyan edges.

pictures.name: card
pictures.prompt: A small glowing cyan spark racer, a sleek rounded hover-pod with no wheels and a bright light core, leaping high through the air over a gap between two glowing neon circuit-board roads that float in the dark, leaving a long bright curving streak of cyan light and a shower of gold sparks, the roads lined with neon cyan edges and glowing gold traces, little green chips along them, a huge glowing gold and green computer world of chips and light far behind under a deep navy sky. No signs, no screens, no writing anywhere. The racer clear and exciting in the middle, wide landscape.
